aggregate_certificate.conclusion: The aggregate received interference satisfies sum_b I_b(t)<=I_max(t)-margin(t).
aggregate_certificate.condition: Every BS enforces I_b(t)<=beta_b(t), beta_b(t)>=0, and sum_b beta_b(t)<=I_max(t)-margin(t).

local_precoder.computation: one local RZF solve plus rank-one projection
local_precoder.power_property: projection never increases BS transmit power
local_precoder.safety_action: closed-form minimum-Frobenius projection of the incumbent-direction component

reference_screen_context.interpretation: The completed 57-sector full-load result remains a severe stress envelope used to size budgets and active sets.

timescales.between_budget_updates: hold the last certified local budget

wmmse_disposition.optional_small_scale_role: A centralized optimizer may be retained only as a labelled small-network upper bound, not as the proposed architecture.
wmmse_disposition.reason: The deployable architecture must not require network-wide instantaneous UE CSI, joint precoder computation, or iterative inter-BS beam exchange.
